author: sjm41
body:
* **PTHR ID & PTN node:**
PTN000045368 (PTHR10410)

* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
Dmel CSN5 (FBgn0027053)

* **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue**
erroneous propagation

CSN5 is characterised as having "metal-dependent deNEDDylase activity (GO:0140758)".
However this node adds "metal-dependent deubiquitinase activity" because CSN5 is included in the [EUKARYOTIC TRANSLATION INITIATION FACTOR 3 -RELATED (PTHR10410)](http://www.pantherdb.org/panther/family.do?clsAccession=PTHR10410)
title: PAINT issue: PTN000045368 (PTHR10410)

author: marcfeuermann
body: There was also an annotation for the human sequence to "metal-dependent deubiquitinase activity". I've blocked the annotation to the node and added the more granular" metal-dependent deNEDDylase activity (GO:0140758)".
